import json
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
import numpy as np

tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-models/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct")

conditions = ["no_trace", "exception_only", "full_trace", "vota", "ae_only"]
results = {}

    test_path = f"/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/debugbench_{cond}_test.jsonl"
    
    train_count = sum(1 for _ in open(train_path))
    test_count = sum(1 for _ in open(test_path))
    
    # Token length analysis on train set

        data = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
    
    lengths = []
    for item in data:

            text = tok.apply_chat_template(item["messages"], tokenize=False)
        elif "text" in item:
            text = item["text"]
        else:

        tokens = tok.encode(text)

        "max_tok": int(lengths.max()),
        "gt_2048": f"{(lengths > 2048).sum()}/{len(lengths)} ({(lengths > 2048).mean()*100:.1f}%)"
    }

# 确认 fail 样本 exception 信号覆盖率

    # 根据数据格式判断 label
    text = str(item)
    if '"fail"' in text.lower():
        fail_total += 1
        # 检查 exception 内容是否非空
        if "messages" in item:
            assistant_msg = [m for m in item["messages"] if m.get("role") == "assistant"]

print(f"\nexception_only fail with signal: {fail_with_signal}/{fail_total} ({fail_with_signal/fail_total*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"Expected: 100% after fix")
